ui.title: A new ruler takes the chair
ui.help: Review the handover preserved at the close of your new ruler’s first resolved season. Convening the council is optional and does not issue orders.
ui.source_note: This is a frozen handover from the end of the succession season, not the exact moment of accession and not current conditions. Later orders may have changed these facts. Historical records do not establish motives or identify the ruler behind a choice.
ui.no_briefing: A handover will be recorded after a future change of ruler. Existing rulers begin silently; earlier accessions are not reconstructed.
ui.stale_note: This handover no longer belongs to the living ruler. A new council will follow the next resolved season.
ui.presentation_note: Finish the season presentation and Dispatch before reviewing the successor’s council.
ui.battle_note: The successor’s council waits until the battle closes.
ui.blocked_note: Resolve the pending defense or campaign ending before convening this council.
ui.pending: The council is ready when you are.
ui.current_council: Return to the current seasonal council
ui.captured: Resolved {season}, {year} · turn {turn}. Handover saved on turn {captured_turn}.
ui.patron_complete: The campaign had recorded this patron’s honor.
ui.no_patron: No divine patron was chosen at this season close.
ui.no_wars: No war stance was recorded for your faction at this season close.
ui.no_edicts: No recognized active provincial edict was recorded in the owned cities.
ui.no_history: No eligible retained historical entry was included.
ui.history_note: Retained history is incomplete. Reign totals are lifetime deeds at closure, and old divine receipts do not prove a policy remained active.
ui.ask_prompt: Review the saved successor handover. Distinguish its end-of-succession-season facts from current conditions and from older historical receipts. Help me choose my next priorities; do not issue orders or invent obligations.
ui.replay_note: This saved handover is historical. The current reports below may describe later conditions.
ui.question: Review the saved successor handover. Distinguish its end-of-succession-season facts from current conditions and from older historical receipts. Help me choose my next priorities; do not issue orders or invent obligations.
ui.patron_note: This records the campaign’s chosen patron and progress at season close, not a personal promise by either ruler.

speakers.marcus: A new reign receives unfinished responsibilities, not a verdict upon its predecessor. Separate the handover’s recorded facts from your present choices; decide what deserves attention first.
speakers.lucius: Taxes and standing edicts tell us what government was asking of its cities at this season close. Review their present effects before changing them; a receipt alone does not establish continuing policy.
speakers.gaius: The handover records war stances, not enemy strength or promises of victory. Check your own available forces, upkeep and routes before committing this ruler to a campaign.

prompt: This is the successor’s first council, revisiting the frozen succession_handover. Its facts were recorded at the end of resolved_season, not the exact accession moment or automatically the present. Compare newer conditions only when current context explicitly provides them. Older history is incomplete: infer no motives, a choice’s ruler, prior pledges, obligations or promises. Read council_discussion for the designated speaker and prior turns; deliver exactly that speaker’s one council turn in at most three short sentences and 60 words. Marcus chairs and weighs responsibilities; Lucius examines institutions and public burden; Gaius examines security, readiness and upkeep. Respond to earlier advice with reasoned agreement or disagreement when relevant, and end with one practical next consideration. Never execute orders or claim an action was taken.
